blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Because traditional toothpaste is desi…
blocks_element.text: Because traditional toothpaste is designed for the manufacturer, not you. Most tubes are 40% water and packed with harsh detergents, cheap fillers, and plastic waste. We’ve condensed everything you need for a dentist-clean feel into a mess-free, travel-friendly Bit. You get a brighter, healthier smile without the irritating chemicals, sticky sinks, or plastic tubes that end up in our oceans. It’s not just a better way to brush—it’s a better way to start your day.

blocks_element.repere: Intertitre · I have sensitive teeth. Will Fluoride …
blocks_element.text: I have sensitive teeth. Will Fluoride Bits work for me?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Absolutely. Most of our customers find…
blocks_element.text: Absolutely. Most of our customers find relief just by making the switch. Bite helps with sensitivity by removing common triggers like SLS—a harsh detergent that can strip your mouth’s protective lining and leave tissue irritated and exposed. We use a gentle coconut-based surfactant and a low-abrasive formula that cleans effectively without wearing down your enamel. If sensitivity is your #1 concern, our Fluoride-Free Bits contain nHAp, which is scientifically studied to help soothe sensitivity.

blocks_element.text: Honestly? Most of our customers say it feels cleaner. Traditional toothpaste is up to 40% water and filled with cheap additives - ingredients that create "foam" but don't actually clean your teeth. Bits are a high-potency, dry formula where every single ingredient has its place. We swapped harsh detergents like SLS for clean, effective alternatives that fight stains, remineralize enamel, and keep your breath fresh for hours. No fillers, no compromises. Just 22,000+ five-star reviews to prove it.
